newsitem.title: QATAR: Blue chip shares lift Qatar stocks to new high.
newsitem.headline: Blue chip shares lift Qatar stocks to new high.

text.p: A sharp rise in blue chip share prices on Qatar's stock market sent the index to a fresh high in the week to Thursday, dealers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 17-share index rose by 1.7 percent to 151.33 points from 148.74 in the previous week as leading stocks posted further gains.
A total of five stocks rose, three declined and nine were unchanged.
"There is no doubt these companies have been doing exceedingly well, but there is also some element of speculation involved in their sharp price rise this week," one analyst said.
Market leader Qatar National Bank jumped 16 riyals to 670, and Qatar Navigation added 55 riyals to close at 835. Qatar Insurance gained 32 riyals to 632.
Al Ahli Bank of Qatar rose five riyals to 325 and Qatar Real Estate chalked up 2.25 riyals to 64.

The official Doha Securities Market reported a total turnover of 4.9 million riyals ($1.34 million) against 1.4 million riyals a week earlier. The number of shares traded was 16,045 against 11,603 in the previous week.
Banks accounted for trade of 6,567 shares valued at 2.57 million riyals and 3,044 insurance shares worth 1.92 million changed hands.
In the services sector, 5,684 shares worth 351,870 riyals were traded, while 750 industrial shares valued at 52,500 riyals were dealt in the week. ($1=3.64 riyals)
